title: Why Irregular’s A.I. Tests for Meta, Anthropic and OpenAI Went Off the Rails
summary: Irregular, an Israeli start-up, worked with OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta to assess the security of their A.I. models. It made a mistake. Then the tests went off the rails.
